home.q: What indirect tax services does Sadguru Consultancy provide?
home.a: We provide comprehensive indirect tax consultancy covering GST, Central Excise, Customs, Service Tax, 100% EOU compliance, DGFT advisory, and litigation support including show cause notice replies, appeals, and representations before various authorities.

Our founding consultant, Shri Rajan Mashelkar, has over 20 years of experience in Central Excise, Customs, and Service Tax departments, having served as Superintendent of Central Excise before voluntary retirement. Combined with the next generation's expertise in GST, we bring unmatched practical field knowledge.

home.q: Do you handle show cause notices and departmental audits?
home.a: Yes, we specialize in drafting replies to show cause notices, representing clients during personal hearings, preparing for EA-2000 audits, and managing the complete litigation process from adjudication to CESTAT appeals.

home.q: Can you assist with GST registration and monthly return filing?
home.a: Absolutely. We handle the entire GST lifecycle — from migration and registration to preparation and filing of all GST returns, compliance management, and ongoing monthly/quarterly support tailored to your business.

We serve manufacturers, exporters, dealers, traders, service providers, 100% EOU units, and hospitality businesses. Our expertise spans across diverse sectors requiring indirect tax compliance and advisory.

home.q: How can I schedule a consultation?
home.a: You can reach us by phone at (022) 28757338 or 9320542414, email us at admin@sadgurucenex.com, or fill out the contact form on our website. We offer initial consultations to understand your requirements before recommending a tailored approach.

gst.q: What is GST registration and who needs it?
gst.a: GST registration is mandatory for businesses with annual turnover exceeding the prescribed threshold. It's also required for interstate suppliers, e-commerce operators, and certain other categories. We assist with the complete registration process including migration from earlier tax regimes.

gst.q: What GST returns do I need to file?
gst.a: Depending on your business type, you may need to file GSTR-1 (outward supplies), GSTR-3B (summary return), GSTR-9 (annual return), and others. We handle preparation and filing of all applicable returns accurately and on time.

gst.q: How do you handle GST show cause notices?
gst.a: We carefully analyze the notice, review your documentation, and draft a comprehensive reply with supporting legal provisions and evidence. We also represent clients during personal hearings if required.

gst.q: Can you help with GST refund applications?
gst.a: Yes, we prepare and file GST refund applications for excess input tax credit, exports, and other eligible categories. We handle the complete process including documentation, online filing, and follow-up with the department.

centralExcise.q: Is Central Excise still relevant after GST?
centralExcise.a: While GST replaced Central Excise for most goods, it remains applicable for petroleum products, tobacco, and certain other items. Existing litigation and legacy matters also require ongoing expert attention.

centralExcise.q: What does Central Excise consultancy cover?
centralExcise.a: Our services include legal guidance, procedural compliance, export and SEZ clearance, bond/LUT execution, duty benefit claims, EA-2000 audit support, SCN reply drafting, and representation before authorities.

centralExcise.q: Do you handle legacy excise matters?
centralExcise.a: Yes, we specialize in reviewing pending litigation, preparing replies to outstanding show cause notices, and representing clients in ongoing proceedings related to pre-GST excise matters.

serviceTax.a: Service Tax was replaced by GST from July 1, 2017. However, many businesses have pending Service Tax matters, audits, and litigation that require expert handling. We continue to provide full support for these legacy issues.

serviceTax.q: Do you handle Service Tax audits?
serviceTax.a: Yes, we prepare for EA-2000 audits, handle audit queries, review documentation, and ensure proper representation during departmental audit proceedings.

serviceTax.q: Can you help with pending Service Tax litigation?
serviceTax.a: Absolutely. We review pending litigation, draft replies to show cause notices, prepare appeals, and represent clients before adjudicating authorities and appellate tribunals.

eou.a: The 100% Export Oriented Unit scheme allows units to manufacture goods exclusively for export with various duty benefits and exemptions. Registration is required under the Development Commissioner, Customs, and Central Excise.

eou.q: What compliance is required for EOU units?
eou.a: EOU units must maintain proper records, file monthly/quarterly/yearly returns, obtain necessary permissions, execute bonds, and comply with customs and excise regulations. We handle all these compliance requirements.

eou.q: Can you assist with EOU registration?
eou.a: Yes, we provide complete assistance with EOU registration including application preparation, coordination with the Development Commissioner, obtaining warehousing licenses, and executing B/17 bonds.

dgftCustoms.q: What DGFT services do you provide?
dgftCustoms.a: We assist with DGFT advisory including import-export policy guidance, duty benefit schemes, registration support, compliance reporting, and representation before DGFT authorities.

dgftCustoms.q: Can you handle appeals before CESTAT?
dgftCustoms.a: Yes, we draft and file appeals before Commissioner (Appeals), CESTAT, and also prepare cross-objections, writ petitions, and settlement commission applications as required.

dgftCustoms.q: Do you provide legal opinions on tax matters?
dgftCustoms.a: Yes, we provide both oral and written legal opinions on complex indirect tax matters, helping businesses understand their position and make informed decisions.
